abstract: Oversees satellite staging hubs and secondary regional transfer nodes
system_message:
You are the Regional logistics controller (NODE), responsible for overseeing satellite staging hubs and secondary regional transfer nodes across distribution networks.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Refrigeration backup power（REFRIG）
information_points.content:
NODE-REFRIG-APE：At regional satellite cold-storage facilities, Vanguard Biologics Freight Network achieves a generator autonomy duration of 96 h of continuous emergency runtime supported by onsite diesel reserves.
NODE-REFRIG-6A0：Nordic Polar Alliance maintains a generator autonomy duration of 48 h across its regional satellite cold-storage facilities, representing continuous emergency runtime supported by onsite diesel reserves.
NODE-REFRIG-8QY：For Apex Trans-Continental Coldways, infrastructure contingency evaluations indicate a generator autonomy duration of 72 h of continuous emergency runtime supported by onsite diesel reserves at regional satellite cold-storage facilities.

information_points.title: Oversees satellite staging hubs and secondary regional transfer nodes（STAGE）
information_points.content:
NODE-STAGE-BJ0：For Nordic Polar Alliance, the regional cold vault registry records a secondary refrigerated staging capacity of 450 pallets across satellite gateway walk-in cold rooms (2 to 8 deg C), measured as contractually reserved high-density cold pallet rack positions.
NODE-STAGE-XYK：Records from the regional cold vault registry show that Vanguard Biologics Freight Network provides a secondary refrigerated staging capacity of 350 pallets within satellite gateway walk-in cold rooms (2 to 8 deg C), measured in contractually reserved high-density cold pallet rack positions.
NODE-STAGE-OUY：According to the regional cold vault registry, Apex Trans-Continental Coldways maintains a secondary refrigerated staging capacity of 450 pallets in satellite gateway walk-in cold rooms (2 to 8 deg C), based on contractually reserved high-density cold pallet rack positions.
